title: Momoi Airi — Special Collab Stream!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Alright, that should be enough ideas. Now I need to turn what I have into a whole segment...)
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Good evening.
Can we ask what you're doing here so late?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was working on the segment for our next stream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was in my room just now, but I decided to come here after Shizuku and the others fell asleep.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Then, can we see what you have?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure.
But it's just a list of ideas at this point.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's see... An advice corner, a “MMJ Relatable Moments Championship”, wake-up pranks and close-up coverage streams of each member.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, all of these sound like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Hey, are you not gonna sing or dance during your next stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We did do a show stream just the other day.
I'm thinking about having us do something with more of a variety feel for our next one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's my wheelhouse, so I'm in charge of coming up with the ideas for it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Now I see!
You are amazing at coming up with those sorts of ideas, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Airi, what's this “hundred-question box challenge” about?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that involves taking questions from our fans and answering a hundred of them in a row.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After I wrote it down, I began to vaguely remember doing the same segment during that dream. I might've written that idea subconsciously.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're talking about the dream you had after you touched those black fragments?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You did say how you'd become a streamer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was apparently pretty popular.
And I got to do a joint stream with Nanamin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even in that dream, you were making lots and lots of people smile, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But...I also wasn't sure how to feel.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because the me in that dream didn't believe the person who appeared on all those variety shows was a real idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why she decided to spread hope to everyone by singing and dancing. In order to become a “real” idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But...the real me knows the truth...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You did everything you could “for your fans”, right? I'm sure you were able to touch the hearts of so many people because of that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They had to believe that tomorrow would be amazing because of you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: But whenever I see you on TV, Happy Everyday, I forget all about feeling lonely.

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: Even when I do feel that way, I can cheer myself up just by thinking about you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The person who appeared on those variety shows was still able to spread hope to others as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Moving forward, regardless of if I'm on a variety show or a stage, I plan on making everybody smile.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In order to do that, I'm gonna come up with fun stream ideas, practice singing and dancing a lot... And do everything else that I possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, someday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll become the idol that I always wanted to be!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You really are such a cool idol, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I promise to give you all the support I can so that you can make your dream come true! Don't hesitate to ask for anything, okay♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Rin, Len.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, we got pretty sidetracked there.
I need to wrap up this segment before it gets too late.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know. Would you two like to help me out with this?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna help!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make it a really good one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it.
Then, let's start with my current list of candidates.
